QuestInfo.name: Time Traveler's Pocket Watch
QuestInfo.0: To activate the Time Gate to Neo City, you need the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch. You heard that you can get this from Andy the Time Traveler.
QuestInfo.1: To activate the Time Gate to Neo City, you need the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch. You heard that you can get this from Andy the Time Traveler.
QuestInfo.2: To activate the Time Gate to Neo City, you need the Time Traveler's Pocket Watch. You visited Andy the Time Traveler, and got what you needed from him.

0.0: Time is like a continuum. It can either sweep you down like a raging river or jump you up like a relentless fish. My current location is... (mumble, mumble)\r\n#L0##bUm... Mr. Andy? What are you talking about?#l\n#k
0.1: What do you want? I'm busy getting everything organized. \r\n#L0##bI want to use the Time Gate.#l\n#k
0.2: What? Why? Time travel is dangerous!

yes.0: Well, if you really want to go, then I'm won't stop you. But, you need a #b#t4001393##k to travel through time. I'll find a #b#t4001393##k for you, so come back in a bit.

no.0: Nothing given, then nothing gained. There's another law for ya. If you have no further business, please go away.

1.0: Here is a Time Traveler's Pocket Watch for you. Now, be very careful. Time currents can easily sweep you off course.
